ui_assets.name: dc-ui-kit
ui_assets.prompt: Please no AI slop or generic vibe. I want it look like if stardew valley & scott pilgrims pixel art styles had a baby, not an exact copy of either. A cozy solarpunk game UI kit sheet, warm golden-hour light, every element with a crisp dark brown 1px outline, a lighter top bevel and a darker bottom lip so it looks chunky and pressable. Elements, all blank with NO text and NO icons: a mossy leaf-green main button, a honey-brown carved wood button, a sunset rose-red warning button, a wooden folder tab, a small round wooden icon button with a brass rim, a square cream parchment item slot with a wood border, and a long cream parchment text input field with an inset wood border. Hand-crafted, Studio Ghibli coziness, readable.
